name: @hamster-note/painting-workspace
description: HamsterNote Painting - React component library with React Native Web

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @hamster-note/painting typecheck && pnpm --filter @hamster-note/painting-board typecheck && pnpm --filter @hamster-note/painting-playground exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:lib && pnpm run build:demo
scripts.prepare:playground-artifacts: pnpm --filter @hamster-note/painting build && pnpm --filter @hamster-note/painting-board build && pnpm --filter @hamster-note/painting-playground fonts:verify
scripts.ci:local: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:ui && pnpm run build && pnpm run pack:dry
scripts.pack:dry: cd packages/painting && npm pack --dry-run && cd ../painting-board && npm pack --dry-run
